reason: PR #20 auth refactoring from DWD+service account to OAuth-only revealed endemic seam-consistency and token-boundary bugs: account-ref namespace disagreement (dwd: prefix accepted in one seam, not another), token scope enforced at mint but ignored at use time, as_user switches unchecked, credentials exposed in URLs, and refactor breaking assumptions at call sites. Future auth reviews in this codebase will benefit from a checklist of these specific patterns.
